account_deletion_cancelled.subject: Your {product_name} account is no longer scheduled for deletion
account_deletion_cancelled.body:
Hello {username},

The scheduled deletion of your {product_name} account has been cancelled. Your account will not be deleted.

{safety_email, select, null {If you have any questions, contact the administrators of this instance.} other {If you have any questions, contact {safety_email}.}}

– {product_name} Team

account_deletion_scheduled_inactivity.subject: Your {product_name} account will be deleted due to inactivity
account_deletion_scheduled_inactivity.body:
Hello {username},

Your {product_name} account has been inactive for a long time, so we scheduled it for deletion on {deletion_date}.

To keep your account, sign in before that date. {support_email, select, null {If you have questions, contact the administrators of this instance.} other {If you have questions, contact {support_email}.}}

The {product_name} team

account_deletion_scheduled_requested.subject: Your {product_name} account deletion is scheduled
account_deletion_scheduled_requested.body:
Hello {username},

As you asked, we scheduled your {product_name} account for deletion on {deletion_date}.

To keep your account, sign in before {deletion_date}. {safety_email, select, null {If you didn't ask for this, contact the administrators of this instance.} other {If you didn't ask for this, contact {safety_email}.}}

The {product_name} team

donation_confirmation.subject: Thank you for your {product_name} donation

donation_magic_link.subject: Manage your {product_name} donations
donation_magic_link.body:
Hello,

Click the link below to access your donor portal:

{manageUrl}

In the portal, you can manage subscriptions, download invoices, and view your donation history.

This link expires on {expiresAt, date, full} at {expiresAt, time, short}.

If you did not request this link, you can safely ignore this email.

– {product_name} Team

dsa_report_resolved.subject: We made a decision on your {product_name} report

dsa_report_verification.subject: Verify your email for a DSA report
dsa_report_verification.body:
Hello,

Use the verification code below to submit your Digital Services Act report on {product_name}:

{code}

This code expires on {expiresAt, date, full} at {expiresAt, time, short}.

If you didn't request this, you can ignore this email.

– {product_name} Safety Team

email_change_new.subject: Verify your new {product_name} email
email_change_new.body:
Hello {username},

Enter this code in the app to verify your new {product_name} email:

{code}

This code expires on {expiresAt, date, full} at {expiresAt, time, short}.

If you didn't request this, you can ignore this email.

– {product_name} Team

email_change_original.subject: Confirm your {product_name} email change
email_change_original.body:
Hello {username},

We received a request to change the email address on your {product_name} account.

To confirm this change, enter this code in the app:

{code}

This code expires on {expiresAt, date, full} at {expiresAt, time, short}.

If you didn't request this, please secure your account right away.

– {product_name} Team

email_change_revert.subject: Your {product_name} email was changed
email_change_revert.body:
Hello {username},

The email address on your {product_name} account was changed to {newEmail}.

If you made this change, no action is needed. If you didn't, you can revert the change and secure your account using this link:

{revertUrl}

This will restore your previous email, sign you out everywhere, disable MFA, and require you to set a new password.

– {product_name} Safety Team

email_verification.subject: Verify your {product_name} email address
email_verification.body:
Hello {username},

Please verify the email address for your {product_name} account by clicking the link below:

{verifyUrl}

If you didn't create a {product_name} account, you can safely ignore this email.

This link is valid for 24 hours.

– {product_name} Team

enforcement_ended.subject: {outcome, select, reversed {We reversed a decision about your {product_name} account} other {A restriction on your {product_name} account has ended}}

enforcement_notice.subject: {neutral, select, yes {An update about your {product_name} account} other {{kind_label, select, warning {A warning about your {product_name} account} suspension {Your {product_name} account is suspended} ban {Your {product_name} account is banned} closure {Your {product_name} account is closed} feature_limit {Some features are limited on your {product_name} account} content_removal {We removed messages you sent on {product_name}} profile_reset {We reset parts of your {product_name} profile} community_removal {We removed your community on {product_name}} bot {An update about your bot on {product_name}} other {An update about your {product_name} account}}}}

gift_chargeback_notification.subject: Perks from your redeemed gift have been removed
gift_chargeback_notification.body:
Hello {username},

A gift code you redeemed was originally paid for by someone else. That payment has since been reversed (a chargeback).

Because of this, we've removed the perks that were added to your account when you redeemed the gift.

{support_email, select, null {If you think this is a mistake, please contact the administrators of this instance and include any details you have about the gift code and when you redeemed it.} other {If you think this is a mistake, please contact our support team and include any details you have about the gift code and when you redeemed it.}}

– {product_name} Team

harvest_completed.subject: Your {product_name} data export is ready to download

inactivity_warning.subject: Your {product_name} account will be deleted due to inactivity
inactivity_warning.body:
Hello {username},

We haven't seen any activity on your {product_name} account since {lastActiveDate, date, full}.

If you don't log in by {deletionDate, date, full} at {deletionDate, time, short}, your account will be permanently deleted due to inactivity.

Log in here:
{loginUrl}

{support_email, select, null {If you've used {product_name} recently, please contact the administrators of this instance right away.} other {If you've used {product_name} recently, please contact our support team right away.}}

– {product_name} Team

ip_authorization.subject: Authorise login from a new IP address

mfa_backup_codes_view.subject: Confirm access to your {product_name} backup codes
mfa_backup_codes_view.body:
Hello {username},

We received a request to view the backup codes on your {product_name} account.

To confirm this request, enter this code in the app:

{code}

This code expires on {expiresAt, date, full} at {expiresAt, time, short}.

If you didn't request this, someone may have access to your account. Change your password immediately.

– {product_name} Team

password_change_verification.subject: Confirm your {product_name} password change
password_change_verification.body:
Hello {username},

We received a request to change the password on your {product_name} account.

To confirm this change, enter this code in the app:

{code}

This code expires on {expiresAt, date, full} at {expiresAt, time, short}.

If you didn't request this, someone may have access to your account. Change your password immediately and enable two-factor authentication.

– {product_name} Team

password_reset.subject: Reset your {product_name} password
password_reset.body:
Hello {username},

You requested a {product_name} password reset. Use the link below to set a new password:

{resetUrl}

If you didn't request this, you can safely ignore this email.

This link is valid for 1 hour.

– {product_name} Team

report_received.subject: We received your {product_name} report
report_received.body:
Hello,

We received your Digital Services Act report about {targetKind, select, message {a message} user {an account} guild {a community} other {content}} on {product_name}.

Report ID: {reportId}

Our Safety Team will review your report and email you at this address once we have made a decision. Keep this email for your records.

– {product_name} Safety Team

report_resolved.subject: Your {product_name} report has been reviewed

self_deletion_scheduled.subject: Your {product_name} account deletion is scheduled
self_deletion_scheduled.body:
Hello {username},

You requested to delete your {product_name} account. Your account is scheduled for permanent deletion on:

{deletionDate, date, full} at {deletionDate, time, short}

If you didn't request this, sign in to your account to cancel the deletion. We also recommend changing your password to secure your account.

– {product_name} Team
